text:
The scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes; every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists unanimously agree that dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres (from 14.5 metres), and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: The berth pocket will be deepened to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity will be 2.1 million TEU after the expansion.

The three-phase expansion programme lays 12.4 km (Phase 1), 8.7 km (Phase 2), and 15.6 km (Phase 3) of new pipe, totalling 36.7 km.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres.

The original opening date was 14 September 2026. An 11-week (77-day) delay was announced. Adding 77 days: 16 days remaining in September + 31 days in October + 30 days in November = 77, landing on 30 November 2026. Three of five panelists confirmed this calculation.

Answer: 30 November 2026

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg at week 16, and 19 participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists unanimously agree that in the placebo group, FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks. The most common adverse event was diarrhoea, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

In the senotrazide arm, 54 out of 450 participants discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding a percentage of 12%.

Answer: 12%

Of 312 participants randomized to the pelvastrin arm, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24 (total non-completers: 60). All remaining participants completed the 24-month follow-up.

Answer: 252

All panelists unanimously agree that Corvane Logistics' order backlog at year end was $386 million and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: Corvane Logistics' order backlog at year end was $386 million, and it guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

All panelists unanimously agree that Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%.

Answer: CET1 ratio: 14.3%; Net interest margin: 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. The percentage growth is (45 / 250) × 100 = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Using the company's definition (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures), Tamberlin Software's free cash flow for fiscal 2025 was $87.3 million − $52.9 million = $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million.

All panelists unanimously agree on the same figures. The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros, which fell below the cap.

Answer: The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

The effective date is 18 February 2025. The 45-day period starts on 19 February 2025 (day 1). Counting: February 19–28 gives 10 days, March gives 31 days (cumulative 41), and April 1–4 gives 4 days (cumulative 45). The 45th day is 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

All panelists agree: the defendant was ordered to pay $2.35 million in compensatory damages (already reflecting a 20% contributory negligence reduction), $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable court costs. Legal fees are not recoverable and excluded.

Answer: $2.88 million.

All panelists agree that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core, as stated in evidence E4.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists agree that the room-temperature ionic conductivity measured for LXP-9 was 0.84 mS/cm, and test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 charge-discharge cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 by 16 yields an average retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year.

The number of breeding pairs declined from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a decrease of 370 pairs. The percentage decline is (370 / 1,480) × 100 = 25%.

Answer: 25%.

All panelists unanimously agree based on the evidence: E3 states 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and E2 confirms the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025. The figure 84,600 cited by some panelists in earlier rounds is unsupported by the evidence.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists agree that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the line was isolated, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

Answer: Approximately 340 kilograms of ammonia were released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage began at 22:47 UTC on 9 October and ended at 03:12 UTC on 10 October, lasting 4 hours and 25 minutes.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

All panelists agree: the incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, yielding 42,000 total attempts. Applying the 30% failure rate gives 12,600 failed checkout attempts.

Answer: 12,600
